lines.t:
The <c:ffff00>attack<c> that sets off a <c:ffff00>combo attack<c>.

If a <c:ffff00>Crossfire<c> attack is linked before or after it, a
combo attack is formed.

Only attacks using a normal <c:ffff00>action<c> can be triggers:
actions using a <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> and <c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c> can't. In a
<c:ffff00>combo<c>, the first action included is the trigger.
